rules_text.raw: When casting this spell, you can specify a particular Spawn of Rovagug— including the Tarrasque, the Armageddon Engine ( Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 262); Chemnosit, the Monarch Worm ( Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Bestiary 47); or Volnagur, the End-Singer ( Inner Sea Bestiary 48)—to call in place of the nameless behemoth spawned by the non-mythic version of this spell. In order to do so, you must expend one use of mythic power plus three additional uses of mythic power per point of Challenge Rating the specified spawn represents above CR 20. These must be expended on the final day of the weeklong ritual to cast the spell.
